_why: TASK-836 (FE, REQ-128 L1). The front session ends exactly when the API token expires (7 days). One test file: real JWT-shaped strings through the real jwt callback with a set clock. M1/M2 the 7-day lifetime, M3 the end-of-session check, M4 the boundary second, M5/M6/M9 fail-closed and the claim read, M7 the 401 sign-out stays.

mutations.what: the NextAuth session maxAge is dropped (back to the 30-day default)
the lifetime goes back to 12 h
🔴 the end-of-session check is removed (the session outlives the API token again)
the boundary flips: the very second of exp is still live
🔴 a missing exp is treated as valid (fails open)
the exp is not read at sign-in (a far-future stand-in is stored)
🚫 the 401 sign-out is narrowed (a revoked/disabled user would no longer be thrown out at once)
the claim read accepts any value as the exp (a string / null exp slips through)

edits.from: return typeof exp === "number" && Number.isFinite(exp) ? exp : null;
